promotions.behavior: Central world-container lifecycle and revisioned atomic transfer orchestration
assumptions: inventory-side removal/addition is committed by the owning subsystem before or after container commit under an orchestration transaction
promotions.safeFallback: reject missing IDs, invalid ownership, capacity, weight, or revision conflicts
promotions.runtimeImpact: enables deterministic shared-container state and transfer requests
promotions.characterSaveImpact: none directly; Character retains inventory persistence
promotions.worldStateImpact: container contents, lock state, decay/reset deadlines, and revision may persist

promotions.behavior: Container lock and trap integration through typed requests
assumptions: container unlock/open interactions may invoke trap processing before item transfer
promotions.safeFallback: return trap request without applying effects and fail closed when key proof is absent
promotions.runtimeImpact: routes trap handling without duplicating Trap ownership

promotions.behavior: Scope-gated world, character, and organization storage
assumptions: original storage families may differ and require native confirmation
promotions.safeFallback: deny access when actor ownership or organization identity does not match
promotions.worldStateImpact: controls access to persisted container state
